meaning: The TCD panel draws measured velocities (cm/s) and the model's cerebral inflow brain.in.q (mL/s) on two separate axes, with no score computed. It lets a reader compare waveform shape during compression while refusing to assert a velocity-to-flow proportionality nobody measured.

could_move.what: Every TCD panel in the jugular-compression figure set: the right-axis scaling of brain.in.q decides how well inflow appears to track velocity, so visual agreement is an axis choice, not a fit.
With no score emitted here, TCD shape mismatch cannot penalise a deck; decks are ranked on other panels only.

expectation: No effect on fitted parameters or scores, since this panel is display-only in this file. The effect on reader interpretation is real but unquantified. I cannot tell whether TCD is scored elsewhere: the reach trace found no references.

check.why: Replots one deck that carries measured data, so the TCD twin-axis panel can be inspected without a re-fit.
